in_hebrew.name: Xenos
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Xenos הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In ancient Greek culture, the name Xenos referred to a foreigner or a traveler. The root of the word comes from the Greek word 'xenos' which means 'guest' or 'stranger'. Xenos was also used in the New Testament to describe a Samaritan who helped a Jewish man in need.

in_greek.name: Ξένος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word ξένος (xenos), meaning 'stranger, guest', derived from ξένιος (xenios), meaning 'hospitable, kind to strangers'. This name was commonly used in the New Testament to refer to non-Jews or Gentiles.
